boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on corridors just beyond the University of Denver campus, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: University Park United Methodist Church
cards.subtitle: South University Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Walk east across University Boulevard to see the church’s Gothic-facing campus edge, then check its official schedule before attending a worship service.
cards.short_summary: A named worship site directly across the boulevard from DU.
cards.evidence_claim: The church lists its location at 2180 S. University Blvd and Sunday worship services.
cards.source_title: Visit Us – University Park United Methodist Church
cards.access_notes: Consult the church’s current service information before visiting.

cards.title: University of Denver Station
cards.subtitle: East Buchtel Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use this named RTD stop on Buchtel Boulevard as a rail-and-bus departure point when your destination extends beyond the immediate campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A transit station on the Buchtel Boulevard side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: RTD identifies University of Denver Station at 1901 E. Buchtel Blvd. with 540 parking spaces.
cards.access_notes: Check RTD’s current schedule, fares, and service alerts before travel.

cards.title: Colorado Station
cards.subtitle: East Colorado Center Drive / South Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Head toward the Colorado Boulevard corridor for this RTD rail stop, then use its listed bus and rail connections to continue your trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby RTD station connecting rail lines and bus routes.
cards.evidence_claim: RTD says Colorado Station serves three bus routes and the E and T rail lines.
cards.access_notes: RTD lists this as a Park-n-Ride with paid parking; verify current transit details before leaving.

cards.title: University Hills Plaza
cards.subtitle: South Colorado Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Follow Colorado Boulevard south to this named retail center at Yale Avenue when you need several shopping and dining options in one stop.
cards.short_summary: A shopping and dining center at Colorado Boulevard and Yale Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: University Hills Plaza lists its address as 2500 South Colorado Blvd., Denver.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own hours and access policies.

cards.title: Harvard Gulch Golf Course
cards.subtitle: East Iliff Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Take East Iliff Avenue west from the campus area for a compact nine-hole par-three course; reserve or confirm operating conditions before playing.
cards.short_summary: A public nine-hole par-three course on East Iliff Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Denver Golf describes Harvard Gulch as a nine-hole par-three course at 660 E. Iliff Avenue.
cards.source_title: Harvard Gulch - City of Denver Golf
cards.access_notes: The course lists seasonal hours that may vary; playing and rentals require purchase.

cards.title: DeBoer (SR) Park
cards.subtitle: South York Street corridor
cards.notes: Continue along the Harvard Gulch Trail toward South York Street to reach the park’s documented playground, basketball court, picnic tables, and path.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood park linked to the Harvard Gulch Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: A federal recreation inventory lists DeBoer (SR) Park at 2505 S. York St. with a playground, basketball court, picnic tables, and Harvard Gulch Trail.
cards.source_title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers recreation inventory
cards.access_notes: Use normal public-park etiquette and observe posted City of Denver rules.

cards.title: City of Kunming Park
cards.subtitle: East Harvard Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow East Harvard Avenue west to pause at this small named park; use its benches and plaza for a brief outdoor break between errands.
cards.short_summary: A small park with plaza seating and flower beds.
cards.evidence_claim: A federal recreation inventory lists City of Kunming Park at 200 E. Harvard Ave. with benches, a plaza, drinking fountain, and flower beds.
cards.source_title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers recreation inventory
cards.access_notes: Use normal public-park etiquette and observe posted City of Denver rules.

cards.title: Rosedale Park
cards.subtitle: East Iliff Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use East Iliff Avenue to reach this named park when you want a route with benches, picnic tables, a community garden, and a bike-pedestrian path.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood park with a garden and path amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: A federal recreation inventory lists Rosedale Park at 300 E. Iliff Ave. with benches, a community garden, picnic tables, and a bike-pedestrian path.
cards.source_title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers recreation inventory
cards.access_notes: Use normal public-park etiquette and observe posted City of Denver rules.

cards.title: Illegal Pete's DU
cards.subtitle: East Evans Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Evans Avenue commercial strip to this restaurant for counter-service food; use the official location page to confirm current ordering and hours.
cards.short_summary: A food stop on the Evans Avenue block beside campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Illegal Pete’s lists its DU location at 1744 E. Evans Ave. in Denver.
cards.access_notes: Food requires purchase; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Jerusalem Restaurant
cards.subtitle: East Evans Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Continue east on Evans Avenue to this restaurant if you want a menu that explicitly includes falafel and a vegetarian combo; order ahead if useful.
cards.short_summary: A Middle Eastern restaurant on East Evans Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Jerusalem Restaurant lists its Denver location at 1890 E. Evans Ave. and includes falafel and a vegetarian combo on its menu.
cards.access_notes: Food requires purchase; the restaurant’s site lists daily hours, which should be confirmed before visiting.
